entries.title: A crewmate asks before changing anything outside its project
entries.body: When a crewmate needs to change something on GitHub or GitLab outside its task's project, such as opening an issue in another repository, changing your account, or creating the GitHub repository for a project kept on this computer, it asks you on a card. The card shows exactly what will be sent, and only your click sends it, once. A crewmate that is only answering a question asks before every change, even in its own project.

picture.alt: A card titled Send this write for me?, showing exactly what it will send to GitHub above Not now and Send it to GitHub buttons.
